entities.name: Rafael Iglesias
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Argentino Rafael Iglesias was an Argentine heavyweight boxer. He won a gold medal at the 1948 Summer Olympics in London, England by knocking out Gunnar Nilsson in the final. Iglesias was knocked out himself in his only bout as a professional, in 1952.
